1. Start by placing a filter paper on the drip funnel and tare.
2. Weigh 70G into 1 liter of Drip Coffee beans into tared stainless cup with the as desired by the business.
3. Place the weighed Drip Coffee Beans into the designated grinder for Drip Coffee Beans only.
4. Position the stainless cup on the spout of the grinder. Make sure the grinder is set to Drip coffee settings.
5. Start grinding the drip coffee beans and when grinding finishes, remove the stainless cup. Never pre-grind coffee.
It is always best to use freshly ground beans for brewed coffee.
Brewing
1. Position the drip funnel with coffee grind below the spray head.
2. Press the desired button for brewing according to grinded amount of beans.
Note:Brewing timing will be the same for all, 5 minutes and 30 seconds
Serving
1. When brewing finishes make sure to have it labeled with a holding time 30 minutes after brewing.
2. Get desired serving cup.
3. Dispense brewed coffee 340g for 12oz and 450g for 16oz into the cup.
4. Serve coffee with smile and advise customers to condiments.
Serve Hot Drip Coffee with smile and advise customers to condiments bar or Serve with 1 Tissue
Note: Average Preparation time is 45 seconds

1. Fully submerge yourpitcher right to the bottom of the spout with cold milk.Fully submerge your thermometer into the milk.
2. Turn on your machine's steam function and purge the steam wand.When you're ready to start.
3. Turn on your espresso machine and allow it to heat to its normal brewing temperature. Place the steam wand just below the surface of the milk.
4. Open the steam valve to full blast.
5. Expand the milk 30°C-40°C
6. Lower steam wand and heat up to 60°C
7. Clean it up the steaming wand when finished.

1.Start by placing an empty and clean blender jug to scale and tare.
2.Pump 180g of sweet sauce into the tared blender jug.
3.Make sure to not over portion the sweet sauce.
4.Directly from milk jug add 1,080g fresh milk into the sweet sauce inside the blender jug.
5.Secure the filled blender jug into the blender.
6.Press button 1 to start blending the mixture and close the lid cover of the blender.Blend for 18 seconds.
7.After the blending time finishes,transfer the mixture into dispenser until it is full.
8.Close the lid of the dispenser and turn on the spray of the dispenser to keep the mixture consistency.
Note: Average Preparation time is 8 Minutes
1.Start by placing an empty and clean blender jug to scale and tare.
2.Add 150g of Matcha Powder into the tared blender jug.
3.Make sure to not over portion the sweet sauce.
4.Directly from milk jug add 1,300g fresh milk into the Matcha Powder inside the blender jug.
5.Secure the filled blender jug into the blender.
6.Press button 1 to start blending the mixture and close the lid cover of the blender. Blend 3 times for 54 seconds.
7.After the blending time finishes,transfer the mixture into dispenser until it is full.
8.Close the lid of the dispenser and turn on the spray of the dispenser to keep the mixture consistency.
